cover.headline: Gators Bitten in Atlanta: Four Turnovers Sink Florida in 27-8 Loss to No. 3 Georgia
cover.dek: No. 3 Georgia beat Florida 27-8 in Atlanta, turning four Gators turnovers into a 24-0 halftime lead.

image.credit: Photo: GatorBait Media.

lines: Score by score, box score and leaders

Georgia week: every story from before kickoff through Monday

damage.title: Four turnovers and a run game that never started
damage.dek: Florida threw for 198 net yards to Georgia's 101, but turned the ball over four times and ran for 54 yards while Georgia ran for 217.

stats.label: Florida turnovers
stats.detail: Three interceptions and a lost fumble. Georgia had one turnover, a lost fumble.

stats.label: Georgia rushing yards
stats.detail: 42 carries at 5.2 yards each. Florida had 54 yards on 28 carries.

stats.label: Florida third downs
stats.detail: Georgia converted 6 of 15 and held the ball 32:10 to Florida's 27:50.

scoring.title: How the points came
scoring.dek: Georgia led 24-0 at halftime. Florida's only points came in the fourth quarter, a touchdown and a two-point conversion, before a Georgia field goal made it 27-8.
